notes.title: STEAM AWARDS
notes.notes: We are presenting PI.EXE for the Love and Labor Steam Award. Hope you enjoyed the game and thank you for the support.  Stay tuned for news about our next project!

notes.title: PI.EXE Enhanced Edition already available on Steam
notes.notes:
Hello players! As we announced last week, the upgraded version of PI.EXE, named as Enhanced Edition is already out today on Steam, and in Nintendo Switch since last friday.

This version matches the released version for Switch and offers different improvements:

[list]
[*] Upgraded visuals with a better light system for neon/cybernetic style
[*] Several improvements in performance, obtaining up to x2 frames per second
[*] Improved storytelling and character dialogues
[*] New world building and environment decoration
[*] New and improved sound effects
[*] New and more intuitive UI
[/list]



We would like to remind you that the base version will remain free on Steam, and this version is released as a DLC for anyone who wants a better experience and support our indie studio.

Thank you very much for supporting PI.EXE and ZenBerry and we encourage you to follow us on our social networks to find out about our new project!

Alejandro Ortiz

notes.title: PI.EXE Enhanced Edition available on Nintendo Switch and PC!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Thank you so much for all the support for our first game, PI.EXE. Over the past year we have received lots of kind comments about the game, and also very important reports about different ways to improve it. We are happy to offer you the best of our efforts to make you have fun! Now we are ready to announce that PI.EXE Enhanced Edition is already available on Nintendo Switch and coming to Steam.

PI.EXE Enhanced Edition is a paid upgraded version set as a DLC for the game with numerous improvements in aspects like UI, story, graphics and performance.

During our path to port PI.EXE to Nintendo Switch, we decided to work on different improvements to offer a better experience for everyone, now we are releasing this edition as a way to match the Nintendo Switch version and as a way of support for our indie studio.

However, you can still play or add the base free version of the game to your library and support the studio in many other ways! That will not change.

Thank you so much for your amazing support, and we are proud to tell you that there will be news about a whole new project soon!

Stay tuned in our social media for more!





										     Alejandro Ortiz

notes.notes:

We will be providing more updates soon.

Thank you!
